<!--
Title: conventional commit format, e.g. "feat: add work filter".
Prefixes: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.
Reference the plan unit when one applies, e.g. "(U2)".
-->

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what this PR does and why. Link the plan or issue it comes from. -->

## Changes

<!-- Bullet list of what changed, grouped by area. Call out anything removed or deprecated. -->

## Decisions

<!-- Choices made while implementing that were not in the plan, with the reason. "None" if none. -->

## Peer Testing

<!-- Numbered steps a reviewer can follow to exercise this themselves: route or
     command, action, expected result. Note anything that needs a specific
     viewport, theme, flag or OS setting. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- Before and after for any visible UI change. Delete the section if not applicable. -->

## Follow-ups

<!-- Known gaps, deferred items, or things a later unit picks up. "None" if none. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows the conventional commit format
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, tests and build pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, backend URLs or environment values committed
- [ ] Docs or plan updated when behavior or scope changed
